concerns.text: SC‑006 – “Dataset‑variable fit is measured by verifying that every predictor and outcome variable in the analysis is present in the source datasets” has no corresponding task; no task validates presence of all required columns in the raw NREL/Materials Project files.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy – title‑token‑overlap validation of citations) is mentioned in the plan but no task implements this verification step, leaving the constitution gate untested.
Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility – pinned random seeds) is asserted in the plan, yet there is no task that sets, records, or verifies a fixed random seed across the pipeline.
